invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.16.0 preserves Parts 1–14 and completes Part 15 Tax Engine with dated/jurisdiction-aware tax rates, tax groups, compound components, fiscal positions and mappings, customer exemptions, tax rules, tax localizations, invoice tax-context snapshots, grouped-tax line snapshots, and standalone route-based Invoicing pages. Create Invoice and Invoice Register are explicitly separated, and all major Invoicing workspaces use first-class URLs. Future changes must keep Invoicing, app-surface, ERP integration, platform closure, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
